definitions.full: H5577. sansin [ סַנְסִנִּים noun [masculine] plural fruit-stalk of date (Löw p. 119 ) (Aramaic loan-word from PS 2617 racemus dactylorum , compare Assyrian sissinnu , part of the date-palm Dl 507 ); — suffix בְּסַנְסִנָּ֑יו אֹחֲזָה Cant 7:9.
